ETag.description: The current entity tag for this representation. Send it back as If-None-Match to revalidate cheaply.

RetryAfter.description: Seconds to wait before retrying (RFC 9110 delay-seconds). A HINT, not a promise: it is the throttling window, so retrying earlier may be refused again, and retrying after it may still be refused if another limiter also applies. Absent on the rare rejection whose limiter reports no window.

XCorrelationId.description: The correlation id chosen for this request (echoed on every response).

IfNoneMatch.description: The ETag from a previous read of this resource. When it still matches, the server answers 304 with no body and the caller keeps its cached copy.
IfNoneMatch.name: If-None-Match

XCorrelationId.description: Optional client-supplied correlation id (bounded token; otherwise the server generates one). Always echoed on the response.
XCorrelationId.name: X-Correlation-Id

ProblemDetails.description: RFC 7807 problem detail emitted by Results.Problem(...).

operatorBearer.description: Operator personal access token (bws_pat_...), presented as a Bearer token.
